listing.name: Banana
listing.summary: Changes the default "missing ship" from a Nebula to a very conspicuous space fruit. Most useful for mod authors to see when they've screwed up.
listing.aiSummary: Replaces the default missing ship placeholder with a conspicuous space fruit to help mod authors spot errors.

description: Replaces the default missing ship placeholder, normally a Nebula, with a conspicuous space fruit. This visual change helps mod authors easily identify when they have made an error.
